notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
Carmen's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Carmen, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
